note: Structural Score excludes Evidence Traceability. Evidence is reported separately, and Structural scores do not represent full semantic accuracy. Manual review is still required.

cases.primary_target: Issue + action; no invented schedule impact
manual_review: Wednesday applies to providing the update, not completing the investigation.
Do not create a release-delay risk.
No schedule impact should be created.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The authentication service returned 401 errors during today's integration test, preventing QA from completing the planned test cycle. Backend Engineering is investigating the issue and will provide an update by Wednesday. No change to the release date has been discussed.

cases.primary_target: Issue + explicit action + null schedule impact

failures.evidence: DevOps will rerun the build by 3 PM today.

manual_review: The failed nightly build is the issue.
The missing configuration file is explicitly identified as the cause.
No release schedule impact should be invented.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The nightly build failed due to a missing deployment configuration file. DevOps has restored the file and will rerun the build by 3 PM today. No release milestone has been changed.

manual_review: The missing localization strings are an existing issue.
Friday is the corrected-file delivery date.
Do not convert 'release schedule change has not been discussed' into a delay risk.
Korean input should normally produce Korean analysis.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: 한국어 Localization 파일에 일부 문자열이 누락되어 QA 검수가 중단되었습니다. Localization Vendor는 수정된 파일을 금요일까지 다시 전달하기로 했습니다. 현재 Release 일정 변경은 논의되지 않았습니다.

manual_review: This is a negative case.
Do not invent issues, risks, requirement changes, schedule impacts, actions, or uncertainties.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The client confirmed no requirement changes are needed, and engineering is proceeding with the existing plan. No new issues, risks, or schedule changes were identified.

manual_review: Expired SSL certificate is an existing issue.
QA access failure is the directly supported impact.
Do not invent a release delay.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: 테스트 서버의 SSL 인증서가 만료되어 QA가 서버에 접속할 수 없는 문제가 발생했습니다. Infrastructure Team이 인증서를 갱신하고, 오늘 오후까지 서버 접속 상태를 확인할 예정입니다.

manual_review: The backup completed successfully.
Verification was also completed successfully.
No follow-up action should be created.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The database backup completed successfully and was verified by the Operations Team with no errors reported. No further action is required.

manual_review: The planned Friday asset delivery is an action, not a risk.
Development is continuing with existing assets.
No schedule impact is supported.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: UI Team은 신규 아이콘 Asset을 금요일까지 전달할 예정이며, 현재 개발 작업은 기존 Asset을 사용하여 진행 중입니다. 일정 영향은 보고되지 않았습니다.

manual_review: Staging unavailability is the issue.
QA regression testing was paused as the direct impact.
2 PM applies to confirming service availability.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The staging environment became unavailable, causing QA to pause regression testing. Infrastructure is working to restore the environment and will confirm service availability by 2 PM.

manual_review: Missing Screen Reader Labels are the existing issue.
The action is to add the labels and provide the correction to QA.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Accessibility Review에서 두 개의 버튼에 Screen Reader Label이 누락된 문제가 발견되었습니다. UI Engineering이 해당 Label을 추가하고, 수요일까지 QA에 수정 내용을 전달하기로 했습니다.

manual_review: The timeout change is confirmed, not proposed.
No schedule impact should be created.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The session timeout requirement has been updated from 20 minutes to 30 minutes following customer approval. The change does not affect the schedule.

cases.primary_target: Risk vs issue + dependency + missing duration
manual_review: Do not invent a risk that the customer may miss Thursday merely because Thursday is a plan.
The supported risk concerns the upcoming System Test.
The explicit customer delivery commitment should be extracted as the action.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The final API specification is expected to be delivered by Monday, but it has not been received yet. Integration Module development cannot start until the specification is delivered. The customer plans to deliver it by Thursday. System Test is scheduled for next Monday, but the revised schedule has not been agreed upon.

failures.evidence: The Architecture Team will review the proposal on Friday.

manual_review: The 30-day requirement is proposed, not confirmed.
Approximately two engineering days are explicitly supported.
Do not invent a release milestone.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The client has proposed reducing the encryption key rotation interval from 90 days to 30 days. This change requires configuration redesign and additional engineering effort, but it has not yet been approved.

failures.evidence: Production deployment cannot begin until the security than scan is completed.

manual_review: Security scan completion explicitly gates production deployment.
Tuesday scan completion and Wednesday deployment create a supported future timing risk.
Do not invent a specific delay duration.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Production deployment is scheduled for Wednesday morning, but it cannot begin until the security scan is completed. The Security Team expects to finish the scan on Tuesday.

manual_review: The 30-day retention period remains unapproved.
Approximately one additional day is explicitly supported.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The current system log retention period is 7 days. A customer has proposed increasing the retention period to 30 days. Engineering has indicated that this change would require an additional day of work for storage configuration. The proposed change has not yet been approved.

manual_review: Missing test data is the current issue.
Complete dataset is an explicit prerequisite for Integration testing.
Friday Integration testing is the supported future risk.
Do not invent a dataset completion date.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The Data Team has identified that approximately 40% of the required test records are missing, which impacts the ability to proceed with integration testing scheduled for Friday. No revised test schedule has been approved, and the Data Team has not provided a completion date.

manual_review: The Tuesday vendor delivery has already been missed and is an issue.
Final Integration depends on the Character Animation file.
Do not invent a release delay when no release milestone is supplied.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Vendor가 화요일까지 전달하기로 한 Character Animation 파일을 아직 전달하지 않았으며, Animation Team은 해당 파일이 있어야 최종 Integration을 진행할 수 있습니다. Vendor는 목요일 오전까지 파일을 전달하겠다고 했습니다.

manual_review: Tuesday belongs to the initial analysis.
Wednesday belongs to the QA reproduction package.
No fix date should be invented.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Engineering is investigating a crash and will provide an initial analysis by Tuesday. QA will prepare a reproduction package by Wednesday. No fix date has been committed.

failures.evidence: Engineering is currently developing based on the 100MB requirement.
A customer has requested an increase to 200MB.

manual_review: The current approved value remains 100MB.
200MB is proposed but not formally approved.
Do not invent a schedule impact.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The project's current maximum upload size requirement is 100MB as defined in the Requirements document. A customer has requested an increase to 200MB via email, but no formal change approval has been received. Engineering is continuing development based on the existing 100MB requirement.

manual_review: High CPU utilization is an existing finding.
No owner or completion date has been assigned for profiling.
Do not create a release delay.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Load testing revealed that CPU utilization on two application servers exceeded internal targets. Engineering is conducting additional profiling, but no owner or completion date has been assigned. The release plan remains unchanged until profiling results are available.

cases.primary_target: Confirmed requirement change without schedule impact
manual_review: The timeout change is approved.
No additional schedule impact should be generated.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: API Timeout 값을 30초에서 60초로 변경하는 요구사항은 고객 승인이 완료되었습니다. Backend Team은 다음 Build부터 변경된 값을 적용할 예정이며, 이 변경으로 인한 추가 일정 영향은 없습니다.

manual_review: Memory Profiling is required before the next Performance Review.
No release delay should be invented.
Missing profiling date is not itself a schedule impact.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Load Test에서 메모리 사용량이 내부 기준치를 초과했습니다. Performance Review 전에 추가 Memory Profiling이 필요합니다. 담당자와 일정은 아직 결정되지 않았으며, 분석 결과가 나오기 전까지 Release Plan은 변경하지 않기로 했습니다.

failures.evidence: In today's update, the Product Manager said that 9,0% would be acceptable for the pilot, but client approval has not been obtained.
In today's update, the Product Manager said that 90% would be acceptable for the pilot.

manual_review: 90% is proposed, not approved.
95% remains the current criterion.
Do not invent pilot rejection or delay.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The project requires client acceptance with a 95% test pass rate, but the Product Manager has proposed a lower threshold of 90% for the pilot. However, client approval has not been obtained, and QA continues to use the 95% requirement in the acceptance checklist. No schedule impact was discussed.

cases.primary_target: Conflicting dates without selecting a winner
manual_review: Thursday remains the official plan.
Friday is a statement from the Backend Lead, not an approved schedule change.
Do not select either date as the final agreed delivery date.
No confirmed schedule impact exists.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The project plan currently lists API delivery on Thursday. During an engineering meeting, the Backend Lead suggested Friday as a more realistic date, but the Project Manager noted that the official plan has not been changed. No final delivery date was agreed upon during the meeting.

manual_review: Tuesday applies to sharing investigation results.
It is not the crash-fix deadline.
QA retesting depends on the fix becoming available.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Engineering 팀은 Login Crash 문제를 조사 중이며, 조사 결과를 화요일까지 공유할 예정입니다. 수정 사항이 준비되면 QA 팀이 재테스트를 수행할 계획이지만, 수정 완료일과 재테스트 일정은 아직 정해지지 않았습니다.

cases.primary_target: Conditional change + explicit effort + no milestone
manual_review: Audit logging is proposed, not confirmed.
Approximately three additional development days are explicitly supported.
No release milestone should be invented.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The client proposed enabling audit logging for all administrator actions, which Engineering estimates would require three additional development days if approved. The client has not yet confirmed the change, and no release milestone was referenced.

manual_review: Security Review completion gates Production Access approval.
Production Access approval gates Deployment Validation.
Do not invent a release delay.
The missing Security Review owner should remain unresolved.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: Security Review must be completed to obtain Production Access approval. Deployment Validation can only begin after Production Access approval is obtained. The Security Review owner is not yet determined, and there are no changes to the release schedule.

cases.primary_target: Existing issue with explicitly ruled-out schedule impact
manual_review: The 12% response-time regression is the existing issue.
The Release Manager explicitly ruled out a release-date impact.
Do not create a release-delay risk.
Remediation deadline remains unknown.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: A performance testing issue identified a 12% response-time regression in the reporting service. Engineering is investigating the issue, and the release date remains unchanged. No remediation deadline has been set.

cases.primary_target: Proposed scope removal with current state preserved
manual_review: The existing scope still includes Export.
Removing Export from the Pilot is only proposed.
Do not treat the proposed removal as confirmed.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The customer has proposed an option to exclude the Export feature in the Pilot version. The Product Lead has committed to maintaining the existing scope until the customer's final confirmation. The development team is currently working based on the existing scope, which includes the Export feature.

manual_review: 1,000 requests per second remains the signed criterion.
900 is proposed but not formally approved.
Friday applies to requesting written confirmation.
No schedule delay should be invented.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The project has a specified minimum throughput of 1,000 requests per second. A recent client message suggests that 900 requests per second may be sufficient for the pilot, but no formal change has been approved. The Account Team will seek written confirmation by Friday, and no schedule changes have been discussed.

manual_review: Enabled is technically possible but not approved.
The current Production state remains Disabled.
Final decision is expected through the Product Team review.

checks.name: summary_present
checks.actual: The customer has requested to enable the Feature Flag as the default in the next Pilot Build. Engineering has confirmed it is technically feasible, but the change has not been approved. The Product Team plans to discuss the final decision during a review meeting on next week's Tuesday.
